description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
